name: Image Scagnostics Validation Dataset
description: Synthetic scatterplots designed to validate image-theoretic scagnostics against graph-theoretic approaches

validation_notes.stringy: EDT ridge path length / diagonal should match MST diameter / (n-1)
validation_notes.sparse: 1 - (closed area / hull area) should match 1 - (alpha area / hull area)
validation_notes.convex: Pixel-based hull should produce similar ratios to point-based hull
validation_notes.skinny: P^2 / (4*pi*A) - identical formula, should match exactly
validation_notes.clumpy: Erosion survival ratio is a proxy for short MST edge ratio
validation_notes.outlying: Erosion residue ratio is a proxy for long MST edge ratio
validation_notes.skewed: 1 - (mean DT / max DT) should correlate with 1 - (mean edge / max edge)
validation_notes.striated: Row fill CV is a proxy for parallel Delaunay edge ratio
validation_notes.monotonic: Row centroid correlation should match point coordinate correlation

scatterplots.name: stringy_chain
scatterplots.description: Horizontal chain - tests if EDT ridge path matches MST diameter

scatterplots.name: stringy_zigzag
scatterplots.description: Zigzag pattern - tests ridge detection on non-straight paths

scatterplots.name: stringy_spiral
scatterplots.description: Spiral pattern - tests if ridges follow curved central axis

scatterplots.name: sparse_scattered
scatterplots.description: Scattered clusters - tests if closing fills gaps like alpha shape

scatterplots.name: sparse_ring
scatterplots.description: Ring/donut shape - tests handling of central void

scatterplots.name: convex_circle
scatterplots.description: Filled circle - should have high convexity in both approaches

scatterplots.name: convex_rectangle
scatterplots.description: Filled rectangle - tests rectangular convex hull

scatterplots.name: concave_crescent
scatterplots.description: Crescent/moon shape - tests concave shape handling

scatterplots.name: skinny_ellipse_5x

scatterplots.name: skinny_ellipse_10x

scatterplots.name: skinny_cross
scatterplots.description: Cross shape - high perimeter relative to area

scatterplots.name: clumpy_clusters

scatterplots.name: clumpy_clusters_tight

scatterplots.name: clumpy_dense_core

scatterplots.name: outlying_distant

scatterplots.name: outlying_tentacles

scatterplots.name: skewed_thick_thin

scatterplots.name: skewed_wedge

scatterplots.name: striated_bands
scatterplots.description: Horizontal bands - should have low row fill variance

scatterplots.name: striated_grid
scatterplots.description: Grid pattern - regular row fills

scatterplots.name: monotonic_positive

scatterplots.name: monotonic_negative
scatterplots.description: Negative diagonal trend - high negative correlation (abs value)

scatterplots.name: non_monotonic_sine

scatterplots.name: baseline_uniform_sparse
